column1: # Selfcheck retrieval probes for lievo's own tree (issue #733).
# Format: query<TAB>expected_repo_relative_path — one pair per line, `#`
# comment lines and blank lines are skipped (parse_probes, selfcheck_metrics.rs).
# Query selection rule: each query must match the target file's file entity
# (name or path) in the `explore` tool's word-match — a single underscore-
#joined token from the filename, or a multi-word query where EVERY word
# appears in the name/path (AND semantics over the word list).
# Maintenance: if a probe target file is renamed or moved, update the
# expected_path (and the query if its wording came from the filename) in
# the same PR. Targets are chosen from long-lived core modules to minimise
